$comment: Single registry for all examples. Adding an example = one source file in examples/ plus one entry here. `deno task generate:examples` (examples/generate.ts) renders every output and publishes sources as docs-site downloads; the integration test fails if an examples/*.ts is missing here or a page is missing. `name` is the slug used for site/static/examples/<name>/ and site/docs pages; `source` is the file in examples/; `page` is the docs page relative to examples/; `outputs[].settings` are --setting.<key>=<value> overrides; `assets` are extra files/dirs in examples/ copied next to the source in site/static/downloads/.
